654-2438-2577-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
654-2438-2577-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

553-5049-7468.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Leyline of Anticipation.
In response, cast Swat Away by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

2793-3017-3743-5089-7824.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3017-3743-5089-7824.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

3484-5391-6774-7824.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
3484-5391-6774-7824.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

4399-4770-6626-7173.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Virulent Emissary trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Virulent Emissary trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-6626-7173.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4753-5399.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4753-5399.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Clever Impersonator and Pirated Copy each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4753-5399.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2034-5003-7266.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sally Pride, adding {C}{C}.
When Sally Pride dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Sally Pride from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Sally Pride enters, it triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

3951-4452-5703-7122.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

2033-3490-5223-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
2033-3490-5223-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

884-3054-3416-5670.easyPrerequisites: You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
884-3054-3416-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire and Oathsworn Vampire enter, Ayara triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life and each opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader twice by paying 2 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire and the Vampire token, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2757-4316-5051-5078.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Traxos, untapping a basic land.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1494-3365-6822-6838.description:
If you have more than three cards in hand, activate Aeromoeba by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have three or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Doctor Octopus triggers, causing you to draw at least five cards.
Lyla triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

224-1846-3584-6618-6657.easyPrerequisites: You control an Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
224-1846-3584-6618-6657.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Cast Relm's Sketching by paying its mana cost, targeting an Island you control.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers. 
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Thousand-Year Storm ability.
Resolve the copy of Thousand-Year Storm's ability, copying the Relm's Sketching spell, targeting an Island you control that enters the battlefield untapped.
Resolve the copy of Relm's Sketching, creating a token copy of the targeted Island.
When the Island token enters, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Gogo.
Activate the Island token by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 4.
224-1846-3584-6618-6657.notes: If you've cast an instant or sorcery spell prior to starting this combo, you will create an additional copy of Relm's Sketching each iteration that can target any applicable permanent. You will also get a copy of High Tide when you cast it, causing you to add an additional {U}{U} when tapping the Islands instead of {U}.

2811-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2811-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Elas il-Kor's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Elas il-Kor's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

3698-4112-4375.description:
Cast Sharuum either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{W}{U}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it and Grinding Station trigger, with Sharuum targeting Technomancer.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Technomancer enters the battlefield, it and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Technomancer.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-1115-2043-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4668-5657-6489.manaNeeded: {4}{C}{C}{C}{G/U}{G/U} plus enough mana to cast the additional Eldrazi spell
4668-5657-6489.notablePrerequisites: You have another Eldrazi creature card in hand.
4668-5657-6489.description:
Cast any other Eldrazi except Drowner of Truth by paying its mana cost, triggering Ulalek.
Holding priority, cast Drowner of Truth by paying {4}{C}{G/U}{G/U}.
Drowner of Truth and Ulalek trigger.
Resolve the Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Drowner of Truth's trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
4668-5657-6489.notes: The cost can be reduced by Heliod if opponent(s) have drawn cards this turn.

1737-3621-4853-5147.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {8} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, Su-Chi Cave Guard and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2933-4359-4499-5798.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

1378-2724-3194.notablePrerequisites: Mirage Phalanx is paired with Wormfang Manta.
1378-2724-3194.description:
At tbe beginning of your combat phase, Mirage Phalanx and Wormfang Manta trigger.
Resolve the Mirage Phalanx trigger, creating a token copy of it with haste and that doesn't have soulbond.
Resolve the Wormfang Manta trigger, creating a token copy of it with haste.
The Wormfang Manta token's first ability does not trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
At the end of your combat phase, the Mirage Phalanx and Wormfang Manta tokens trigger, exiling themselves.
The Wormfang Manta token's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

618-859-1496-4613.notablePrerequisites: Lurking Roper has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
618-859-1496-4613.description:
Activate Lurking Roper using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Lurking Roper token enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Lurking Roper's toughness.
Each Lurking Roper you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.
You may also target any nonlegendary creature you control.

1987-2556-3120.notablePrerequisites:
Mindsplice Apparatus has at least two oil counters on it.
You control a permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
1987-2556-3120.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and the mana-producing permanent.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

202-1742-3878.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
202-1742-3878.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Faith of Devoted triggers, causing you to pay {1} to cause each opponent to lose 2 life, and you to draw two cards due to Lich.
Repeat.

453-2154-2743.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other creatures.
453-2154-2743.description:
Cast Sylvan Tutor by paying {G}, causing you to search your library for Biovisionary, then shuffle your library and put Biovisionary on top of it.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Deceiver of Form triggers, revealing Biovisionary from the top of your library and causing all other creatures you control to become copies of Biovisionary until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Deceiver of Form and each Biovisionary trigger.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

132-2347-2645.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Firemind Vessel's ability by tapping it, adding two mana of different colors.
Activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
132-2347-2645.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use any other ability from Staff of Domination in step 1 instead.

1987-2427-3277.notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
1987-2427-3277.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Izzet Chronarch and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.
